Since the April 2025 Supreme Court ruling, two severe-when-triggered risks apply if arrested: police forces strip-search trans women according to biological sex (with male officers), and trans women are placed in men

records.name: Germany
records.summary_text: Germany is very safe for transgender visitors, with two real caveats. First, far-right street hostility is the most documented concern: roughly 110 of 245 Pride events in 2025 were disrupted or attacked, over half linked to organised far-right networks, so a visitor at Pride or visibly trans in the eastern regions faces elevated harassment. Second, arrest exposure: if arrested, prison placement generally follows your self-chosen civil-registry gender entry under recent state-level reforms, but exceptions allow placement contrary to your self-declared gender and are invoked inconsistently —
